messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — carrier flagged AWB LX1234567890 for customs hold in FRA. ETA bumped to 03/26. Anyone seeing this affect Dedicated pool?

kevin_procure: saw that, we're expecting 12 H100s in that shipment. Vendor says they can split AWB but will hit +$1200 air uplift.

ashley_logistics: confirmed with forwarder — customs needs additional commercial invoice. We can re-route to AMS or break into two consignments. AMS adds 1 day transit + handling fee.

dean_infra: If AMS works, can we accept partial deliver to EU staging? We need at least 6 GPUs to unfreeze some batch jobs.

maria_ops: yes, we need 6 to cover apac testing windows. @kevin_procure can you push split?

kevin_procure: pinged vendor. They propose partial release (6 units) with RMA placeholders for serial mismatch. Price delta +$950 for split paperwork.

ashley_logistics: Also RMA note: depot 3 requires AO698 manifest for serial temp IDs. I can prepare labels if we go split.

maria_ops: what's the risk on serial mismatch for us? dean?

dean_infra: mismatch means we can't tag in inventory -> manual reconcile. Ops time ~ 2 hours per unit. Not great but doable.

kevin_procure: vendor offered to cover return shipping for DOA up to 2 units per 100 free of charge; anything above charged at list. Negotiate?

maria_ops: push for 0-charge DOA for first 4 units given lead times.

ashley_logistics: carrier says we can get earlier release if we provide pre-logged serials. Not possible until goods scanned, circular.

maria_ops: ok plan: accept split AWB -> request 6 units immediate to AMS -> prepare AO698 temp labels -> I'll coordinate customs invoice -> @kevin_procure negotiate DOA buffer to 4 units and ask supplier to waive split uplift.

kevin_procure: on it. I'll escalate with pricing team and cc legal for PO amendment. ETA update if vendor agrees: release by 03/24.

rma_bot: NOTICE: RMA ticket #RMA-78321 created for serial placeholders. Assigned to ashley_logistics.

ashley_logistics: acked RMA-78321. I'll post labels and manifest tonight.

maria_ops: thanks. small ask — can we route 1 GPU to US warm pool as redundancy? Shipping cost roughly $600 extra.

dean_infra: yes please, route 1 to SJC warm pool. We'll absorb cost if shipping < $700.

kevin_procure: vendor agreed to 4 DOA buffer and waived split uplift if we accept AMS route. They need signed amendment by EOD.

maria_ops: signed. sending PO amendment now.

ashley_logistics: labels attached in drive: internal link: https://drive.internal/reports/labels/1709881234 — I'll follow up with AWB once assigned.

kevin_procure: AWB assigned LX1234567890 split into LX1234567890A (6 units -> AMS) LX1234567890B (rest -> SJC). Estimated customs clear AMS 03/24.

maria_ops: great. monitor customs, ping infra if anything delays. :eyes:
